item.title: Site Work Underway for First Centre County Wawa
item.description: Centre County's first Wawa is inching closer to becoming a reality. Heavy equipment arrived last week on the parcel at the intersection of Benner Pike and Eagle Point in Benner Township for the start of site work on the first of the convenience store and gas station chain's four planned stores in the county. item.title: College Township Approves Final Plan for First Phase of Large Residential Development Near Shiloh Road
item.description: College Township Council on Thursday unanimously approved final plans for the first phase of a development that will bring hundreds of new residential units in the Dale Summit area. Burkentine Builders' 48-acre planned residential development will be constructed on the west side of Shiloh Road and north of Trout Road. item.title: Centre Foundation Honors Community Leaders, Retiring President
item.description: More than 100 supporters, donors and nonprofit leaders gathered on Dec. 9 at Centre Hills Country Club, for Centre Foundation’s annual Holiday Soirée, an event celebrating philanthropy and recognizing distinguished community leadership. The event featured a special tribute to Molly Kunkel, who recently retired after 17 years of leadership and service to the Centre County community. item.title: Penn State OL Alex Birchmeier to Enter Transfer Portal
item.description: After an uneventful tenure at Penn State, another Nittany Lion is headed elsewhere. Redshirt sophomore offensive lineman Alex Birchmeier intends to enter the transfer portal when it opens in January, he announced Friday night on social media. Birchmeier spent three seasons at Penn State, seeing just 34 offensive snaps and 147 on special teams. item.title: Penn State Wrestling Sets NCAA Division I Record for Consecutive Dual Meet Wins
item.description: Add another historic achievement to Cael Sanderson's tenure as Penn State wrestling coach. The Nittany Lions won their 77th consecutive dual meet with a 42-0 victory over Stanford on Saturday night, eclipsing the previous NCAA Division I record of 76 set by Oklahoma State from 1937-51. item.title: Last of Centre County’s Commemorative Liberty Bells Unveiled Ahead of America 250 Celebration
item.description: Community members joined state and local officials in Bellefonte on Friday night to unveil the last of four commemorative bells in Centre County that are part of the celebration of the United States' 250th birthday in 2026.
